name: agent-security-vet
description: Static security vetting for the AI-agent supply chain (offline scanner; the separate page fetcher needs network): check whether a Claude Code skill, plugin, MCP server or repository is safe before you install it, check articles and web pages for hidden prompt injection and for the truth of their claims, and audit a browsing-agent setup with benign canary pages. Python standard library only; never runs what it scans. No hooks, no MCP servers.
